content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds the Customer anywhere in this MSA — Section 1 expressly disclaims it.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred position: it imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on AP. Section 1 (p0001) affirmatively disclaims any exclusive arrangement and expressly preserves AP's right to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties. A full-text sweep for "exclusive", "sole", requirements-purchase and non-compete language found no Customer-side restriction: the remaining "exclusive" references are a non-exclusive license grant to Customer (p0002, favourable), exclusive jurisdiction (p0064), each Party's exclusive ownership of its own marks (p0065), the entire-agreement clause (p0072) and the no-third-party-beneficiary clause (p0073) — none of which restrict AP's freedom to buy from other suppliers. Services are scoped through Exhibits (p0001, p0023); no exhibit exclusivity appears in the body, so if any Exhibit is later executed we should confirm it carries no exclusive-supply commitment. No redline required.
